resources.string: Fit shows the complete picture. Crop fills the screen and trims its edges. Original size uses video pixels, including its pixel aspect ratio. This mode is saved for all videos.
Pinch with two fingers to zoom from 0.5× to 4× relative to the selected mode. Zoom is centred and resets for a new video. Text subtitles and controls keep their size.
The countdown continues while paused and when the screen is off. At the deadline, playback pauses and keeps its position. Leaving playback or opening another video cancels the timer.
Stopping after the video requires a known duration. For live streams, use a countdown.
